songs.title: Forever
songs.note:
Forever - written in about 5
 hours on Oct 7th. This song is
 IMO the best ive done. Maybe
 this will hush the people who
 said i could only do techno :)

songs.title: The Passage Of Time
songs.note:
The Passage of Time was written
over a few months, on and off.
The song begins at dawn and ends
at dusk with a sunset. I hope
you enjoy it! :)  -Ryan Cramer

songs.note:
I really like the sound I got in
this one. Its a nice change of
pace from your typical demo music.
I hope all of you guitar lovers
enjoy it... Later!
